INTEL COLOGNE MAJOR 26

sections.text: Major returned to the Cathedral of Counter-Strike. The stories this tournament created will stay with fans for a very long time. NiKo finally lifted his first Major trophy with Falcons. Magixx delivered an unbelievable 1v4 clutch. m0NESY's performance, and I could go on. The content from this event generated over 1 million organic impressions on my Instagram. Photo gallery soon.

FOOTBALL

sections.text: Every match is a story in motion — emotion, rhythm, and the unspoken language of teamwork. From the first whistle to the last echo of the crowd, football is raw energy captured in motion. It’s the beauty of precision and chaos of competition. Every shot, every save, every celebration tells a story of strength, focus, and belief.

ICE HOCKEY

sections.text: Hockey is more than a game — it’s a battle of speed, precision, and heart. Every shift on the ice is a clash of power and control, where seconds decide heroes and silence breaks into thunder. The cold air bites, the skates carve, and the puck moves faster than thought — yet within the chaos, there’s beauty.

EVENT EXPERIENCE

sections.text: From the roaring crowds of E3 in Los Angeles, to the electric atmosphere of Gamescom, and the intensity of ESL tournaments, LoL Worlds, and beyond — every event tells its own story. Each light, sound, and cheer becomes part of a living world — one built on passion, competition, and connection.

RALLY PRAGUE REVIVAL

sections.text: This weekend, I headed to Rallye Prague Revival with my colleague Matěj, who’s also a photographer, and I was really excited to see what the event had in store for us. Amazing atmosphere, classic cars with real character, the smell of fuel, dust, puddles and mud.

URBEX

sections.text: Hidden behind broken windows and forgotten walls lies a world frozen in time. Each abandoned place carries the whispers of stories long left behind — echoes of life, industry, and dreams now reclaimed by nature. Peeling paint becomes art, shattered glass reflects memories, and empty halls breathe with a haunting kind of beauty.

Comic-Con 2024

sections.text: Meeting Ghost, Jack Sparrow, and other iconic characters from the world of games and movies all in one day? No problem at Comic-Con Prague. Here’s a short photo report from the event. I didn’t have as much time this year since I was also filming another fair during the same week, but still – a busy yet fantastic start to April.
